newsitem.title: GERMANY: German teenager suspected of major blackmail scam.
newsitem.headline: German teenager suspected of major blackmail scam.

text.p: German police said on Friday they were investigating allegations that a 16-year-old girl in the suburban Frankfurt city of Floersheim had forced a 15-year-old girl to pay her more than 30,000 marks ($20,000) over a five-year period.
Another student also allegedly later joined in the extortion and netted about 2,000 marks, police sources said.
The blackmail apparently began when one of the girls, then 11 years old, threatened to tell the other girl's parents that she had a boyfriend -- in defiance of her parents' wishes.
She initially asked for small amounts of money but then became more aggressive, forcing the girl to take funds from the cash register of her parents' restaurant.
The plot was uncovered when her parents started to notice the amount of funds missing from the till and called police.
"This 15-year-old was blackmailed by another student and apparently forced to pay out money on a daily basis, something like 50 to 100 marks at the end," a police official said.
